blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.
blocks.zh: 原生的3D生成主要围绕潜在扩散,最近的进展集中于更强的变异自编码器(VAE),并日益细化从维塞特和triclanes到结构化的稀疏的Voxel的潜在表示. 尽管它们的建筑差异,这些方法都有一个相同的前提:几何首先被压缩成一个潜伏的空间,然后才由生成器模拟. 我们采用不同的路线,提出Direct3D-V3,一种潜在的无扩散变压器(DIT)框架,将VAE完全丢弃,在原生的Voxel域内运行,在培训和取样期间直接模拟原始的SDF voxel网格. 为了让这种直接的 voxel 配方几何上可靠, 我们引入了一种隐含的多重规范 相对于邻邻的 voxel 来抑制非水密表面, 通过 Marching Cube 将预测的 SDF 网格转换成 meshes , 这样正常的丢失可以直接从它的预测 SDF 来监督模型。 为了改进调制图像与生成几何的对齐,Direct3D-V3还预测了调制图像的相机参数作为辅助任务,鼓励DiT学习从图像观测到3D形状的绘图. 这种潜在的无潜质设计消除了重建瓶颈,将培训置于本土毒物领域的一个目标之下,并产生更丰富的本地细节。 预测的相机和原生的SDF voxel输出进一步使Direct3D-V3扩展至基因重建,其扩散与正常的制导改进相交,以更好地与观测到的观点保持一致,而基因先前完成的未见区域. 项目页:https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
Recent years have seen rapid progress in 3D shape generation, driven by advances in generative modeling and large-scale 3D datasets. This progress has opened up a wide range of applications, from game and film asset creation to AR/VR content authoring and robotic simulation. In many of these settings,
the practical goal is to recover a high-fidelity 3D mesh from reference images while preserving faithful geometry, fine surface details, and alignment to the observed view.
blocks.zh:
近年来,在基因建模和大规模立体数据集的进步的推动下,3D形状生成取得了快速进展. 这一进展开辟了从游戏和电影资产创造到AR/VR内容的编写和机器人模拟等广泛的应用. 在许多这样的场合,
其实际目标是从参考图像中回收一个高纯度的3D网格,同时保留忠实的几何,精细的表面细节,并与观测到的视图保持一致.

blocks.en:
The dominant recipe for this problem is latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . A variational autoencoder (VAE) is first trained to compress 3D shapes into a latent space, and a diffusion model is then trained to generate within that space.
Following this recipe, recent work has largely focused on how to parameterize the VAE latent space. Existing designs can be broadly organized into vecset representations ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , triplane ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , and structured sparse-voxel latents ( Li et al., 2026b ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Although these designs encode geometry differently, they share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a learned latent representation and only then modeled by the generator.
This latent paradigm carries two limitations for high-fidelity geometry generation. First, VAE reconstruction acts as an information bottleneck: fine details lost during encoding cannot be recovered by the downstream diffusion model. Second, the two-stage pipeline introduces an objective mismatch, because the VAE is optimized for reconstruction whereas the diffusion model is optimized to match the learned latent distribution. The generator is therefore constrained by both the fidelity of the learned representation and the gap between independently trained objectives.
These observations suggest that further refinement of latent design is unlikely to remove either limitation, and motivate us to revisit the premise of latent compression itself.
blocks.zh:
这一问题的主要途径是潜在的扩散(Rombach等人,2022年)。 首先培训一个变异自编码器(VAE),将3D形状压缩成潜在空间,然后培训一个扩散模型,以便在该空间内生成。
按照这一方法,最近的工作主要侧重于如何将VAE潜在空间参数化。 现有设计可以大致排列为vecset表示式(张等,2023年;张等,2024年),triplane. (Wu等人,2024年),以及结构化的稀疏伏牛潜质(Li等人,2026b;Xiang等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年). 虽然这些设计编码几何学不同,但它们有着相同的前提:几何学首先被压缩成一个学习到的潜在代表,然后才由生成器建模.
这种潜伏的范式为高真几何生成带来了两个限制. 首先,VAE重建起到信息瓶颈的作用:编码过程中丢失的精细细节无法被下游扩散模型回收. 第二,两阶段的管道引入了客观的不匹配,因为VAE被优化用于重建,而扩散模型则被优化以匹配学到的潜在分布. 因此,发电机受到所学表现的忠诚和独立训练目标之间的差距的限制。
这些意见表明,进一步完善潜在设计不可能消除任何限制,并促使我们重新审视潜在压缩本身的前提。

blocks.en:
We therefore take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that operates in the native voxel domain by directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling.
This places the generator in the same signal space where geometry is ultimately evaluated, but also makes scalability the central challenge: a dense SDF volume grows cubically with resolution. To address this, we adopt a dual-granularity architecture: a patch-level DiT reasons about coarse semantics and global layout on a sparse sequence of patch tokens, while a lightweight voxel-level DiT restores fine geometric detail at voxel granularity. This coarse-to-fine organization reflects a broader principle in high-resolution pixel-space diffusion ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) : global structure and high-frequency detail are easier to model when they are handled at compatible granularities. For 3D geometry, surface sparsity makes this principle particularly effective, since the most informative signed-distance variation lies near the zero-level set.
Concretely, the patch-level model operates on surface patches, while the voxel-level model predicts high-frequency details within selected patches.
Together, these modules make native SDF diffusion tractable at 1536 3 1536^{3} .
blocks.zh:
因此,我们采取不同的路线,提出Direct3D-V3,一种潜在的无扩散变压器(DIT)框架,通过在培训和取样期间直接模拟原始的SDF voxel电网,在原生的Voxel域内运行.
这使得发电机处于最终评价几何的同一信号空间,但也使得可伸缩性成为中心挑战:一个密集的SDF体积随分辨率的增大而成立方体. 为了解决这个问题,我们采用了一种双角结构:一个补丁级的DiT理由,即粗糙的语义和在零散的补丁符号序列上的全局布局,而轻量级的voxel级的DiT则在voxel颗粒性时恢复精细的几何细节. 这种粗细的对细组织在高分辨率像素空间扩散中反映了一个更广泛的原则(Wang等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年):全球结构和高频细节在相容颗粒处理时更容易建模. 对于3D几何来说,表面伸缩使得这个原理特别有效,因为最信息化的签名-距离变异位于零级集附近.
具体来说,补丁级模型运行在表面补丁上,而voxel级模型则预测选定补丁内的高频细节.
这些模块一起使本地SDF的传播在1536 3 1536 ^{3} .

blocks.en: Operating directly on SDF voxels introduces a new optimization challenge, but also opens up a new form of geometric supervision. On the one hand, even small perturbations in predicted SDF values can cause Marching Cubes to extract non-watertight surfaces with open boundaries, a failure mode that VAE decoders tend to suppress implicitly by learning the manifold structure of meshes. We address this issue with an implicit manifold regularization loss that penalizes abrupt SDF discontinuities between neighboring voxels, substantially reducing non-watertight artifacts in practice. On the other hand, once the DiT predicts raw SDFs, each grid can be converted directly into a mesh via Marching Cubes, allowing rendered normal losses to supervise the SDF voxel output through the extracted mesh. A related idea was explored by Hi3DGen ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , but its reliance on VAE decoding for normal rendering incurs substantial memory overhead, limiting its applicable resolution to 256 3 256^{3} . By contrast, our approach operates without such a bottleneck, scaling to resolutions as high as 1536 3 1536^{3} , and the resulting normal supervision yields measurable improvements in both the visual quality and geometric fidelity of the generated meshes. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape.

blocks.en: With the predicted camera and native SDF voxel output, Direct3D-V3 can be extended to generative reconstruction. The camera supplies the input view for test-time refinement, while the raw SDF grid provides geometry that can be optimized without repeatedly passing through a heavy VAE decoder. Building on this interface, we first use a pre-trained normal prediction model to estimate the normal map of the input image. We then extract a mesh from the predicted SDF via Marching Cubes, render the mesh normal map under the predicted camera, and optimize the discrepancy between the rendered normal and the predicted normal. We interleave this normal-based refinement with diffusion sampling, allowing the reconstruction signal to tighten alignment with the input image while the generative prior continues to complete unseen regions and regularize the surface.
blocks.zh: 随着预测的相机和原生的SDF voxel输出,Direct3D-V3可以扩展至基因重建. 相机为测试时间的改进提供输入视图,而原始的SDF网格则提供几何功能,可以在不反复通过重型VAE解码器的情况下进行优化. 在这个界面的基础上,我们首先使用预先训练的普通预测模型来估计输入图像的正常地图. 然后我们通过 Marching Cubes 从预测的SDF 中提取一个网格, 使预测的相机下的网格正常地图, 并优化 变换的正常和预测的正常之间的差异。 我们把这种基于正常的改进与扩散取样结合起来,使重建信号与输入图像更加一致,而先基因继续完成看不见的区域并使表面正常化。

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions of this paper are: • We propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free DiT framework that trains and samples directly on raw SDF voxel grids in the native voxel domain and scales to a resolution of 1536 3 1536^{3} through a dual-granularity architecture. • We equip the native voxel formulation with three complementary signals: implicit manifold regularization for SDF consistency, rendered normal supervision for surface detail, and an auxiliary camera branch for alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry. • We further show that the latent-free design extends naturally to generative reconstruction, enabling effective normal-guided test-time refinement while preserving the geometric prior learned by the generator. • Extensive experiments on image-to-3D generation show that Direct3D-V3 achieves competitive or superior performance to state-of-the-art latent-based methods, while producing meshes with finer geometric detail and better alignment with the input image.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,本文件的主要贡献是: • 我们提议Direct3D-V3,一个潜在的无阻DiT框架,通过双角结构,直接在原生的SDF voxel网格和天平上对1536 3 1536^{3}的分辨率进行训练和取样。 我们为原生的阴道配体配备了三个互补信号:对SDF一致性的隐含多重规范化,对表面细节的正常监督,以及用于调节图像和生成几何的辅助摄像头分支。 我们进一步表明,无潜伏设计自然延伸至基因重建,从而能够有效地改进正常制导的试验时间,同时保留发电机先前学到的几何技术。 • 图像到3D生成的广泛实验显示,Direct3D-V3实现了对最先进的潜在方法的竞争或优异性能,同时生产更细微的几何细节和更好的与输入图像的配合。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 2. Framework of Direct3D-V3. Rather than compressing geometry into a learned latent representation, Direct3D-V3 trains and samples directly on raw SDF voxel grids. During training, we extract the SDF voxel grid and surface patch SDF values from the ground-truth mesh, and add Gaussian noise to the surface patch SDF values to form the DiT input 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} . During inference, the first-stage model is used only to provide the surface patch indices; sampling then starts from Gaussian noise on these sparse patches, and the latent-free DiT predicts the clean SDF values directly in the native voxel domain. The patch-level DiT uses the noisy SDF signal, DINOv2 image tokens, and timestep embedding to reason efficiently over global shape semantics, while a lightweight voxel-level DiT refines voxel-level SDF values within each selected patch. In parallel, a camera prediction branch combines patch-level features with image tokens to regress normalized intrinsic and extrinsic parameters, encouraging the generated shape to remain spatially aligned with the conditioning image.
blocks.zh: 图 2. Direct3D-V3的框架. Direct3D-V3列车和直接在原始的SDF voxel网格上采样,而不是将几何压缩成一个学到的潜在代表. 在训练期间,我们从地面真实网格中提取SDF voxel网格和表面补丁SDF值,并在表面补丁SDF值中加入高斯噪声,形成DiT输入x t\mathbf{x}_{t}. 在推论期间,第一阶段模型仅用于提供表面补丁指数;然后从这些稀疏补丁上的高斯噪声开始采样,而潜伏无源的DiT则直接在原生的voxel域中预测干净的SDF值. 补丁级的DiT使用响亮的SDF信号,DINOv2图像符号,以及跨全球形状语义上高效地嵌入理性的时间步,而轻量级的voxel级的DiT则在每个选定的补丁内精炼voxel级的SDF值. 同时,一个相机预测分支将补丁级特性与图像符号相结合,使正常的内在参数和外在参数倒退,鼓励生成的形状保持与条件图像的空间对齐.

blocks.en: 2.1. Native 3D Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 本地三维一代

blocks.en: Recent progress in 3D generation has been dominated by latent diffusion pipelines, in which a variational autoencoder first compresses geometry into a compact latent space and a diffusion model is then trained to generate in that space ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . Within this paradigm, one important line of work builds on vecset ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) representations, which provide an implicit latent description of 3D shape through a fixed-length set of tokens that can be decoded into neural fields. CLAY ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) scales this representation to controllable large-scale 3D asset generation. TripoSG ( Li et al., 2025 ) further combines vecset latents with large-scale rectified flow training to improve synthesis fidelity. Dora ( Chen et al., 2025a ) and Hunyuan3D 2.0 ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) study this line from the VAE perspective, showing that sharp edge sampling and stronger cross-attention improve the preservation of fine geometric structures during shape autoencoding.
blocks.zh: 3D生成的近期进展以潜在扩散管道为主,其中可变自编码器首先将几何压缩成紧凑的潜在空间,然后对扩散模型进行在该空间生成的培训(Rombach等人,2022年)。 在这个范式中,一条重要的工作线建立在vecset(张等人,2023年)的表示法上,通过一组固定长的可解码成神经域的代号,为3D形状提供了隐含的潜伏描述. CLAY(Zhang等人,2024年)将这种表示比例表用于可控制的大型立体资产生成. TripoSG(Li等人,2025年)进一步将vecset潜伏物与大规模修正流培训结合起来,以提高合成忠贞性。 朵拉 玛拉 (Chen et al., 2025a)和Hunyuan3D 2.0(Zhao et al., 2025)从VAE的角度研究了这条线,表明尖端采样和较强的交叉注意在形状自动编码过程中改善了细几何结构的保存.

blocks.en: Another representative family uses explicit triplane features. Direct3D ( Wu et al., 2024 ) factorizes the latent into three orthogonal feature planes, injecting explicit positional structure into the latent representation and making diffusion modeling easier to scale than purely implicit token sets. Hyper3D ( Guo et al., 2025 ) further augments the triplane latent with a low-resolution 3D grid latent, which supplements explicit 3D information and supports higher resolution representation with more efficient training.
blocks.zh: 另一个具有代表性的家族使用明显的绊脚石特征. Direct3D(Wu等人,2024年)将潜伏物分解为3个正交特征平面,将显式位置结构注入潜在代表物中,使扩散模型比纯隐性符号集更容易进行比例化. Hyper3D(Guo等人,2025年)通过低分辨率的3D网格潜伏进一步扩大了三维网格潜伏,它补充了清晰的3D信息,并通过更有效的培训支持更高的分辨率代表.

blocks.en: A third and rapidly growing family uses sparse voxel structures as the latent representation. TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) proposes the unified structured latent representation, which can be decoded into multiple downstream 3D formats, including NeRF ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) , FlexiCubes ( Shen et al., 2023 ) , and 3D Gaussian Splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) . Direct3D-S2 ( Wu et al., 2026 ) introduces spatial sparse attention, which significantly improves both training and inference efficiency for high resolution generation. SparseFlex ( He et al., 2025b ) focuses on high resolution shape modeling with arbitrary topology, extending sparse structured generation to more flexible geometric outputs. Sparc3D ( Li et al., 2026b ) introduces a sparse deformable marching cubes representation that can efficiently convert raw meshes to high resolution watertight ones. TRELLIS2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) introduces a new sparse voxel structure, O-Voxel, that can jointly encode geometry and appearance in a compact native representation. Despite their differences in architecture and engineering, all of these methods still rely on compressing geometry into a learned latent space before generation. Our work departs from this common assumption and asks whether the latent stage can be removed entirely.
blocks.zh: 第三个迅速增长的家庭使用稀疏的阴道结构作为潜在代表。 TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025年)提出统一的结构化潜在代表,可以解码成多个下游3D格式,包括NERF(Mildenhall等人,2021年),FlexiCubes(Shen等人,2023年),3D Gaussian Splating(Kerbl等人,2023年). blocks.en: 2.2. Latent-Free Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.2. 晚期免费传播模式

blocks.en: The idea of training diffusion models directly in data space has deep roots in image generation. Early models such as DDPM ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , Improved DDPM ( Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ) , ADM ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) , and EDM ( Karras et al., 2022 ) all operate directly in pixel space and establish the effectiveness of end-to-end denoising in the original signal domain. As model scale increased, however, many works shifted to latent space for efficiency. LDM ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) made latent compression the dominant recipe for high-resolution diffusion, and transformer-based generators such as DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) and U-ViT ( Bao et al., 2023 ) further strengthened this trend by showing that large transformer backbones remain highly effective when operating on compact latent tokens.
blocks.zh: 直接在数据空间中培训传播模型的想法在图像生成中有着深刻的根基. DDPM(Ho等人,2020年),改进DDPM(Nichol和Dhariwal,2021年),ADM等早期模型. (Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021),以及EDM(Karras等人, 2022年)都直接在像素空间中运行,并在原始信号域中建立端到端去诺的有效性. 然而,随着模型规模的扩大,许多工程转移到潜在的提高效率空间。 LDM(Rombach等人,2022年)将潜在压缩作为高分辨率扩散的主要食谱,变压器的发电机如DiT(Peebles and Xie,2023年)和U-ViT(Bao等人,2023年)进一步加强了这一趋势,表明大型变压器骨干在紧凑的潜伏物上运行时仍然非常有效.

blocks.en: Recent work has returned to the question of whether latent compression is necessary at all. JiT ( Li and He, 2025 ) argues that diffusion models should directly predict clean data rather than noise-like quantities, and shows that simple large patch transformers can already become strong pixel-space generators without tokenizers or auxiliary losses. DiP ( Chen et al., 2025b ) studies how to make pixel-space diffusion practical at higher resolution by combining a DiT backbone with a lightweight patch detailer head, balancing global structure modeling with local detail synthesis. DeCo ( Ma et al., 2025 ) observes that modeling low-frequency semantics and high-frequency details with a single transformer is inefficient, and therefore decouples them using a semantic DiT, a lightweight pixel decoder, and a frequency-aware flow matching objective. PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2025 ) instead adopts a fully transformer-based dual-level design, where a patch-level DiT captures global semantics and a pixel-level DiT restores texture details directly in pixel space. These methods show that latent-free diffusion can be competitive for image generation, but they cannot be directly transferred to 3D generation, where SDF voxel grids are sparse, memory-intensive, and coupled to mesh extraction. SDF-Diffusion ( Shim et al., 2023 ) provides an early 3D counterpart by avoiding VAE compression, yet its generation is limited to 128 3 128^{3} resolution, which restricts the geometric precision of the resulting shapes. Our Direct3D-V3 extends the latent-free principle to high resolution native 3D generation by operating on surface SDF voxel grids and scaling to resolutions such as 1536 3 1536^{3} .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作又回到了潜在压缩是否有必要的问题。 智图 (Li and He, 2025)认为扩散模型应该直接预测干净的数据,而不是类似噪声的数量,并表明简单的大型补丁变压器已经可以成为强力的像素-空间发电机,而不需要指示器或辅助损失. DiP (Chen et al., 2025b)研究如何通过将DiT主干线与轻量级补丁分解器头结合,使像素空间传播在更高分辨率下实用,平衡全球结构模型与局部细节合成. DeCo(Ma等人,2025年)观察到,用单变压器模拟低频语义学和高频细节效率低下,因此使用语义DiT,轻量级像素解码器,频率感知流匹配目标来解耦. 像素DiT (Yu等人,2025年)转而采用完全变压器双层设计,即补丁级DiT捕捉全球语义,像素级DiT直接在像素空间中恢复纹理细节. 这些方法表明,潜在的无线传播可以对图像生成具有竞争力,但不能直接转移到3D生成,因为SDF voxel网格稀少,内存密集,与网格提取结合. SDF-Difusion(Shim et al., 2023)通过避免VAE压缩提供了早期的3D对应物,然而它的生成仅限于128 3 128^{3}的分辨率,这限制了所形成的形状的几何精度. 我们的Direct3D-V3通过在地表SDF voxel网格上操作并缩放到像1536 3 1536^{3}这样的分辨率,将无潜伏原理延伸至高分辨率的本地3D生成.

blocks.en: 2.3. Generative Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.3. 基因重建

blocks.en: One important line of work uses image diffusion priors to improve image-to-3D reconstruction. Zero-1-to-3 ( Liu et al., 2023 ) learns viewpoint-conditioned novel view synthesis from a single image and shows that a diffusion prior with explicit relative camera control can already support zero-shot 3D reconstruction. SyncDreamer ( Liu et al., 2024 ) improves this direction with a synchronized multi-view diffusion model that generates all target views jointly and correlates them through 3D-aware feature attention, substantially improving cross-view consistency. Wonder3D ( Long et al., 2024 ) predicts both multi-view color images and multi-view normal maps through cross-domain diffusion, then fuses these geometric cues into textured mesh reconstruction. InstantMesh ( Xu et al., 2024 ) combines an off-the-shelf multi-view diffusion model with a sparse-view large reconstruction model and a differentiable iso-surface extraction module, enabling high-quality mesh generation in only a few seconds. These methods significantly improve coarse structure recovery, novel view consistency, and surface appearance, but their optimization is still driven primarily by image-space consistency rather than direct alignment of fine geometry with the observed input view.
blocks.zh: 一个重要的工作线是使用图像传播前科来改进图像到3D重建. Zero-1-to-3(Liu et al., 2023)从单一的图像中学习观点条件化的新观点合成,并显示在显式相对相机控制之前的传播已经可以支持零镜头3D重建. 同步梦想器 (Liu et al., 2024)通过同步多视图传播模式改进这一方向,通过3D-意识特征关注,共同生成所有目标观点并将其关联起来,大幅提高交叉视角一致性. Wonder3D (Long et al., 2024)通过跨域传播预测多视图彩色图像和多视图正常地图,然后将这些几何提示导入纹理网格重建中. InstantMesh(Xu等人,2024年)将现成的多视传播模型与稀释的大型重建模型和异位表面提取模块相结合,仅几秒钟就能实现高质量的网状生成. 这些方法大大提高了粗结构恢复,新颖的视图一致性,以及表面外观,但其优化仍然主要受图像-空间一致性的驱动,而不是直接将细几何与观测到的输入视图对齐.

blocks.en: Another related line exploits video diffusion priors for view synthesis and reconstruction. Stable Virtual Camera ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) formulates generative view synthesis as a general diffusion model conditioned on arbitrary input views and target camera trajectories, producing temporally smooth novel views under large viewpoint changes. GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) further introduces a 3D cache built from depth predicted on seed images or previous frames, and conditions video generation on renderings of this cache under user-specified camera trajectories. This design yields more precise camera control and stronger temporal 3D consistency than prior video diffusion models. These methods offer richer camera-aware priors than single-image diffusion, but their supervision still lives mainly in image or video space and is not directly tied to mesh-level geometric detail.
blocks.zh: 另一条相关线路利用视频传播前科进行视图合成和重建. Stable Virtual Camera (Zhou et al., 2025) 以任意输入视图和目标相机轨迹为条件,将基因观合成为一般传播模型,在大视角变化下产生时间平滑的新观点. GEN3C(Ren等人,2025年)进一步引入了从种子图像或之前的帧上预测的深度的3D缓存,并在用户指定的相机轨迹下为这种缓存的渲染提供视频生成条件. 这种设计产生比之前的视频传播模型更精确的相机控制以及更强的时间立体一致性. 这些方法提供了比单像传播更丰富的相机认识前科,但其监督仍然主要存在于图像或视频空间,并不直接与网格几何细节联系在一起.

blocks.en: Closest to our setting are methods that place reconstruction constraints inside generation itself. ReconViaGen ( Chang et al., 2025 ) designs global geometry conditions for coarse structure, local per-view conditions for fine geometry and texture, and rendering-aware velocity compensation to correct the denoising trajectory toward the input views. CUPID ( Huang et al., 2025 ) uses a two-stage flow pipeline: it first predicts an occupancy cube and a UV cube to estimate the object-centric camera, then uses a pose-aligned conditioner to inject pixel-aligned image features for detailed geometry and appearance. Pixal3D ( Li et al., 2026a ) generates 3D assets in a view-aligned space to better preserve image-to-3D correspondence and input details. Our method follows this direction, but benefits from a simpler native interface: the latent-free DiT directly outputs SDF voxel grids rather than an intermediate latent representation. This allows the generated geometry to be converted into a mesh by Marching Cubes, rendered under the predicted camera, and directly aligned to normal maps estimated from the input view by a pre-trained normal predictor. As a result, our framework can push fine geometric detail to match the input image more directly, rather than focusing mainly on overall structure or texture.
blocks.zh: 离我们环境最近的方法 是把重建的局限 放在世代本身。 侦察局 (Chang 等人,2025年)设计粗结构的全球几何条件,细几何和纹理的局部透视条件,以及渲染速度补偿,以纠正向输入视图的去诺化轨迹. CUPID(Huang等人,2025年)使用两阶段流线管:它首先预测一个占用立方体和一个UV立方体来估计以物体为中心的相机,然后使用姿势对齐的调制器来注入像素对齐的图像特征来进行详细的几何和外观. 像素3D (Li et al., 2026a)在视图对齐的空间中生成3D资产,以更好地保存图像到3D的对应和输入细节. 我们的方法遵循这个方向,但从更简单的本土界面中获益: 潜在的无源DiT直接输出SDF voxel 网格,而不是中间潜在表示. 这使得生成的几何可以由Marching Cubes转换成网格,在预测的相机下制成,并直接与由预先训练的普通预测器从输入视图中估计的普通地图对齐. 因此,我们的框架可以推动精细的几何细节更直接地匹配输入图像,而不是主要专注于整体结构或纹理.

blocks.en: 3. Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers for 3D Generation
blocks.zh: 3个 用于3D 世代的Latent- Free 扩散变换器

blocks.en: Existing latent-based methods compress 3D shapes into an intermediate latent space, introducing an unavoidable fidelity gap between the original geometry and what the diffusion model ultimately learns to generate. To circumvent this fundamental limitation, Direct3D-V3 performs training and sampling directly on raw SDF voxel grids, eliminating the VAE entirely, as detailed in Section 3.1 . To balance geometric expressiveness with computational tractability at high resolutions, Direct3D-V3 employs two complementary DiT modules operating at patch and voxel granularity respectively, decoupling coarse shape semantics from fine-grained surface detail, as described in Section 3.2 . To ensure the geometric validity of generated shapes, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization that enforces smooth SDF transitions between neighboring voxels, detailed in Section 3.3 . Since the model predicts SDF voxel grids directly, we can also extract meshes with Marching Cubes and apply rendered normal supervision in the geometric space, as detailed in Section 3.4 . Finally, the framework additionally predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image, which pushes the generated mesh to align more closely with the input view, as elaborated in Section 3.5 . An overview of the framework is shown in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 现有的基于潜伏的方法将3D形状压缩成中间潜伏空间,在原始几何学和扩散模型最终学会生成的东西之间引入了不可避免的忠诚差距. 为规避这一基本限制,Direct3D-V3直接在原始的SDF voxel网格上进行培训和取样,完全取消VAE,详情见第3.1节。 为了平衡几何表达式与高分辨率时的可计算性,Direct3D-V3使用两个互补的DiT模块,分别以补丁和voxel颗粒性操作,将粗糙的形状语义与精细的表面细节脱钩,如第3.2节所述。 为了保证生成的形状的几何有效性,我们引入了一种隐含的多重规范化,在相邻的阴道之间实现SDF平稳的过渡,详见第3.3节. 由于模型直接预测了SDF voxel网格,我们也可以用Marching立方体提取网格,并应用使几何空间的正常监管,详情见第3.4节. 最后,如第3.5节所述,框架还另外预测了调制图像的相机参数,从而推动生成的网格与输入视图更加一致。 框架概况见图2。

blocks.en: 3.1. Latent-Free Diffusion on SDF Voxel Grids
blocks.zh: 3.1. 在SDF Voxel网格上进行Latet-Free传播

blocks.en: Latent diffusion has become a practical way to reduce the cost of high-dimensional generation, but in 3D shape generation the compression stage also constrains the geometry that the diffusion model can learn. A 3D VAE must encode detailed surface structures into a compact representation and later decode them back to geometry, which can discard fine local detail and introduce the reconstruction bottleneck discussed above. The latent space is also optimized for reconstruction fidelity rather than for the distributional objective used by diffusion, leading to a mismatch between the two training stages. We therefore discard the latent space and train the diffusion model directly in the voxel domain, using raw SDF voxel grids as the generative state.
blocks.zh: Latet扩散已经成为降低高维生成成本的实用方法,但在3D形状生成中,压缩阶段也制约了扩散模型所能学习的几何学. 3D VAE必须将详细的表面结构编码成一个紧凑的表示,然后将它们解码回几何,这可以丢弃细微的局部细节,引入上面所讨论的重建瓶颈. 潜在的空间也为了重建忠心而优化,而不是为了传播所使用的分配目标,导致两个培训阶段之间的不匹配。 因此,我们放弃潜在的空间,直接在 voxel 域中训练扩散模型,使用原始的 SDF voxel 网格作为基因状态.

blocks.en: Geometric Formulation on SDF Voxel Grids. We represent a 3D shape as a uniform SDF voxel grid 𝐗 ∈ ℝ R × R × R × 1 \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{R\times R\times R\times 1} , where each voxel stores a SDF value, and R denotes the grid resolution. While our latent-free formulation is in principle compatible with other volumetric representations such as FlexiCubes ( Shen et al., 2023 ) , Sparc3D ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and O-Voxel ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , we deliberately adopt this minimal representation to validate our core hypothesis that latent-free diffusion can match or surpass latent-based methods without relying on any sophisticated representation design.
blocks.zh: SDF Voxel Grids上的几何配体. 我们代表一个三维形状,作为统一的SDF voxel网格 X ∈ R × R × R × 1\ mathbf\\in\ mathbb{R}^{ R\times R\times R\times 1},其中每个voxel存储一个SDF值,R表示网格分辨率. 虽然我们的无潜质制剂原则上与FlexiCubes(Shen等人,2023年),Sparc3D(Li等人,2026年b),以及O-Voxel(Xiang等人,2026年)等其他体积表达方法相容,但我们有意采用这种最小的表达方法来验证我们的核心假设,即无潜质扩散可以匹配或超越潜质表达方法而不依赖于任何复杂的表达设计.

blocks.en:
Surface Patch Tokenization. Directly operating on a dense voxel grid of resolution R 3 R^{3} is computationally prohibitive for the attention mechanisms in DiT. To reduce the token sequence length, we partition the voxel grid into non-overlapping patches of size p 3 p^{3} , yielding ( R p ) 3 (\frac{R}{p})^{3} patch tokens, each of dimensionality p 3 p^{3} . However, even with patch tokenization, the number of tokens at high resolutions such as 1536 3 1536^{3} remains large. We further exploit the observation that SDF values are only meaningful in the vicinity of the mesh surface, and adopt a sparse surface voxel representation that restricts computation to surface-adjacent patches. Concretely, we follow the two-stage generation paradigm that has become standard practice in high-resolution 3D generation methods such as TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , Direct3D-S2 ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and LATTICE ( Lai et al., 2025 ) . In the first stage, we employ a model to rapidly generate a coarse mesh at low resolution, from which we identify the set of occupied surface patches 𝒮 \mathcal{S} .
In the second stage, our latent-free DiT performs diffusion exclusively over these sparse patches, operating on the token sequence { 𝐱 i ∈ ℝ p 3 ∣ i ∈ 𝒮 } \left\{\mathbf{x}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{p^{3}}\mid i\in\mathcal{S}\right\} ,
where | 𝒮 | ≪ ( R / p ) 3 \lvert\mathcal{S}\rvert\ll\left(R/p\right)^{3} .
The first-stage model is only used to localize surface patches and is not a focus of this paper. In practice, this stage can be implemented in the same spirit as existing high-resolution multi-stage pipelines: one may generate a coarse mesh with a vecset-based model and extract the corresponding patch indices, or predict the occupied patch set directly with a dense voxel DiT as in TRELLIS. Our method is agnostic to this choice, as long as it provides the surface patch index set 𝒮 \mathcal{S} for the high-resolution latent-free DiT.
blocks.zh:
表面补丁切换 直接运行在分辨率为R 3 R^{3}的密集的阴道网格上,在计算上对于DiT中的注意机制是令人无法接受的. 为了缩短符号序列长度,我们把阴道网格分割成不重叠的补丁,大小为p 3 p^{3},产生(R p) 3 (\frac{R}{p})^{3}补丁符号,每个尺寸为p 3 p^{3}。 然而,即使贴补符号化,像1536 3 1536 ^{3}这样的高分辨率的符号数量仍然很大. 我们进一步利用这样的观察,即SDF值只在网状表面附近才有意义,并采用稀疏的表状阴道表示,将计算限制在表面相邻的补丁上。 具体地说,我们遵循两阶段的生成模式,这种模式已成为高分辨率3D生成方法的标准做法,如TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025年),Direct3D-S2(Wu等人,2026年)和LATTICE(Lai等人,2025年)。 在第一阶段,我们使用一种模型在低分辨率时快速生成粗网格,从中我们确定一组占用的表面补丁S\mathcal{S}.
在第二阶段,我们的潜伏无线DiT完全在这些稀疏的补丁上进行扩散,运行在符号序列 {x i i ∈ ∈ R p 3 ∣ i ∈ S }\left \{\mathbf{x}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{p^{3}}\mid i\in\mathcal{S}\right\}},
其中 S = Q = = (R / p ) 3\lvert\ mathcal{ S =rvert\ll\ left(R/p\right)} 。
第一阶段的模型仅用于将表面补丁本地化,不是本文的重点. 在实践中,这个阶段可以和现有的高分辨率多级管线一样的精神执行:一个人可能用基于vecset的模型生成粗网,并提取相应的补丁指数,或者像TRELLIS那样用密集的voxel DiT直接预测占用的补丁集. 我们的方法对这个选择是不可知的,只要它为高分辨率潜在自由DiT提供表面补丁索引集S\mathcal{S}.

blocks.en: 3.2. Dual-Granularity DiT Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2. 双重定向 DiT 架构

blocks.en:
While sparse patch tokenization substantially reduces the sequence length for attention computation, it introduces a tension between efficiency and geometric fidelity. A large patch size keeps the number of tokens manageable, but results in patch embeddings of high dimensionality p 3 p^{3} , making it difficult for a single DiT to simultaneously model global shape semantics and recover fine-grained
surface detail. Conversely, operating directly at voxel granularity preserves geometric detail but renders attention computation intractable. Inspired by the frequency decoupling strategy of DDT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , which separate low-frequency semantic content from high-frequency detail, we propose a Dual-Granularity DiT architecture that decomposes this challenge across two complementary modules: a patch-level DiT that models coarse shape semantics and global layout at patch granularity, and a lightweight Voxel-level DiT that restores fine-grained geometric detail at voxel granularity, conditioned on the output of the patch-level DiT. The architecture is illustrated in Figure 3 .

This dual-granularity design avoids applying expensive attention to all voxel tokens directly, yet still preserves the fine geometric detail needed for high-resolution shape generation.

blocks.en: Figure 4. Illustration of the Implicit Manifold Regularization (IMR). Without the decoder-induced geometric prior used in latent-based pipelines, a latent-free DiT can predict locally inconsistent TSDF fields, leading to abrupt zero-level crossings and non-watertight meshes after Marching Cubes. Since the surface manifold is implicitly defined by the zero level set of the TSDF, we regularize this manifold by penalizing neighboring voxels whose predicted SDF values differ by more than one voxel length η \eta . This local constraint encourages coherent TSDF transitions around the surface, reducing holes and producing a more watertight extracted mesh while preserving the generated shape.

blocks.en: 3.3. Implicit Manifold Regularization
blocks.zh: 3.3. 隐性货币规范化

blocks.en: Removing the VAE changes not only the representation space, but also the geometric prior available to the generator. In latent-based methods, the VAE decoder is trained to reconstruct valid 3D shapes and therefore implicitly learns the local structure of plausible SDF fields around mesh surfaces. Since the mesh surface is extracted as the zero level set of the SDF, this local distance-field structure acts as an implicit prior on the extracted surface manifold. As a result, even noisy or inaccurate compressed features can often be decoded into a watertight surface without large holes. A latent-free DiT lacks this decoder-induced prior: small local errors in predicted SDF values can create inconsistent zero crossings after Marching Cubes, producing meshes with holes or non-watertight regions. We address this issue with implicit manifold regularization, which does not directly constrain mesh topology, but regularizes the local TSDF field that implicitly defines the surface manifold.
blocks.zh: 删除 VAE 不仅改变表示空间,而且改变生成器先前可用的几何图形 。 在潜在的方法中,VAE解码器被训练来重建有效的3D形状,因此隐含地学习了网状表面周围可信SDF场的局部结构. 由于网状表面是作为SDF的0级集提取的,这种局部的远场结构在提取的表面多面之前起到隐含的作用. 因此,即使是吵闹或不准确的压缩特征也常常可以解码成没有大孔的紧水面. 无潜伏的DiT缺乏这种解码器前引起的:预测的SDF值中小的局部误差在3月立方体后会产生不一致的零交叉,产生有孔或非水密区域的网间. 我们用隐含的多重规范来解决这个问题,它并不直接限制网状地貌,而是将当地TSDF领域规范化,从而隐含地表多面的定义.

blocks.en:
Eikonal regularization is commonly used in 3D reconstruction to constrain learned implicit fields. In our setting, however, the DiT is directly supervised by ground-truth TSDF values, while the Eikonal loss enforces a unit 2-norm gradient at arbitrary spatial points. This constraint can conflict with the empirical TSDF distribution, making DiT optimization unstable and in severe cases causing training collapse. We therefore impose a discrete Lipschitz constraint on neighboring voxels, as illustrated in Figure 4 .
Let 𝐗 ^ \hat{\mathbf{X}} denote the predicted TSDF grid and let η \eta be the physical length of one voxel. For each pair of neighboring voxels ( i , j ) ∈ 𝒩 (i,j)\in\mathcal{N} , a valid TSDF field should not change by more than one voxel length. blocks.en: Normal-based supervision has also been explored by Hi3DGen ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , but it is applied in a latent-based pipeline. The DiT prediction in Hi3DGen must first be decoded by a VAE decoder before a mesh can be extracted and rendered for normal supervision. This additional decoding step is feasible at relatively low resolutions such as 256 3 256^{3} , but becomes memory-intensive at high resolutions such as 1536 3 1536^{3} . In contrast, our latent-free DiT outputs the SDF voxel grid directly, so Marching Cubes and normal rendering can be applied without any VAE decoding. This makes native geometric optimization practical even at high resolution.

blocks.en: 3.5. Camera Parameter Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.5. 相机参数预测

blocks.en: To strengthen the spatial correspondence between the input image and the generated geometry, we further add a camera prediction branch to the latent-free DiT. Since Direct3D-V3 targets object-level generation rather than scene reconstruction, we adopt an object-centric look-at camera model. In this setting, the object is assumed to be centered in a canonical coordinate frame, and the camera is described by its viewing direction, distance, field of view, and image-plane offset. This avoids unnecessary free variables for object-level conditioning while still capturing the view variation needed to align the generated geometry with the conditioning image.
blocks.zh: 为了加强输入图像与生成的几何的空间对应,我们进一步在潜无的DiT中增加了一个相机预测分支. 由于Direct3D-V3瞄准对象级生成而不是场景重建,我们采用了以对象为中心的外观相机模型. 在此设定中,假定物体以舟形坐标框为中心,摄影机则通过它的视向,距离,视场,以及图像平面偏移来描述. 这避免了对对象级条件不必要的自由变量,同时仍然捕捉到将生成的几何图形与条件图像对齐所需的视图变异.

blocks.zh: 4. 应用:基因重建

blocks.en:
Figure 5. Generative reconstruction pipeline. Given the input images, we use pre-trained predictors to estimate the corresponding foreground mask and normal map as auxiliary observations. The key reconstruction mechanism lies in how these cues are coupled with the latent-free DiT output: the mask calibrates the predicted camera, while the normal map drives direct refinement of the predicted SDF voxel grid.
At each guided sampling step, the DiT proposes a clean SDF grid together with an image-view camera. We first align the rendered mask with the estimated one to correct the camera, and then compare rendered surface normals with the

blocks.en: The latent-free DiT can be used not only as a generator, but also as a native 3D prior for reconstruction. Given a single input image, standard image-to-3D generation samples a plausible complete shape conditioned on the image, but the generated surface may still deviate from the observed view in fine geometric detail. Our framework exposes two quantities that make test-time reconstruction natural: the DiT predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image, and its clean prediction is the SDF voxel grid itself. We therefore refine the sampling trajectory directly in the SDF domain by comparing normals rendered from the predicted mesh with normals estimated from the input image. This turns the generator into a reconstruction prior: the diffusion trajectory maintains plausible unseen geometry, while the visible surface is corrected by an explicit geometric signal from the input view. The generative reconstruction pipeline is illustrated in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: 无潜伏的DiT不仅可以用作发电机,也可以在重建前用作本地的3D. 鉴于一个单一的输入图像,标准图像到3D生成的样本在图像上标注了一个假想完整的形状,但生成的表面仍然可能在细微的几何细节上偏离观测到的视图. 我们的框架暴露出两种使试时重建自然化的量:DiT预测了调制图像的相机参数,其干净的预测是SDF voxel网格本身. 因此,我们通过将预测网格提供的正常情况与输入图像估计的正常情况进行比较,来完善直接在SDF领域的取样轨迹。 这使得生成器变为重建前的:扩散轨迹保持了可信的隐形几何,而可见的表面则通过输入视图中的显式几何信号进行校正. 图5说明了基因重建管道。

blocks.en: This native geometry path is what makes the reconstruction procedure practical. In a latent-based pipeline, each inner optimization step must decode an intermediate latent representation into geometry before mesh extraction and rendering, which makes iterative test-time refinement expensive at high resolution. In our framework, Marching Cubes and differentiable rendering are applied directly to the DiT output, and gradients can be propagated back to the SDF grid itself. The normal predictor supplies a view-aligned geometric observation, the camera branch supplies the approximate image-to-shape pose, and the latent-free SDF output supplies the optimizable geometry. Together, these components form a closed reconstruction loop in the native geometry domain.
blocks.zh: 这种本土几何路径使得重建程序变得实用. 在基于潜伏的管道中,每个内在优化步骤必须在网格提取和渲染前将中间潜伏的表示解码为几何,这使得迭代测试时间的完善在高分辨率下昂贵. 在我们的框架中,三进制立方体和异构渲染直接应用于DiT输出,梯度可以传播回SDF网格本身. 正常的预测器提供视向对齐的几何观测,相机分支提供近似图像对形状的姿势,而潜伏的SDF输出则提供可选择的几何. 这些组件共同构成了本土几何域的闭合重建环.

blocks.en: 4.2. Observation Alignment in the Predicted View
blocks.zh: 4.2. 预测观点中的观测一致

blocks.en: Before applying normal guidance, we align the predicted view with the input observation. Although the camera branch is trained to predict the relative camera parameters of the conditioning image, small errors in azimuth, elevation, distance, field of view, or image center can shift the rendered normal map relative to the input. Optimizing SDF values under such a misaligned view would push the geometry in the wrong direction. We therefore first refine the predicted camera using the foreground mask, which is robust to local normal ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 在应用正常的引导之前,我们先将预测的视图与输入观察对齐. 虽然相机分支被训练来预测调制图像的相对相机参数,但方位角,高程,距离,视场,或图像中心的小错误可以使渲染的正常映射相对输入进行偏移. 在这种错位观点下优化SDF值,会把几何推向错误的方向. 因此,我们首先利用前景面具改进了预测的照相机,这个面具对当地正常的模糊性很强。

blocks.en: 4.3. Generative Refinement along the Sampling Trajectory

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Generative Reconstruction with Native SDF Refinement
blocks.zh: 算法 1 与土著 SDF 一起进行基因重建

blocks.en: We interleave SDF refinement with diffusion sampling rather than applying it only after generation finishes. We apply reconstruction guidance only when t < t 1 t<t_{1} : although the current noisy state 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} is not yet a final geometry, the DiT already predicts a clean SDF estimate 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0} , which can be rendered and corrected to steer the subsequent generative trajectory. Once t ≥ t 1 t\geq t_{1} , we stop reconstruction guidance and let the DiT continue standard denoising without additional test-time optimization.

We set 𝐱 0 ⋆ \mathbf{x}_{0}^{\star} to the refined SDF grid when reconstruction guidance is applied, and to the DiT prediction 𝐱 ^ 0 \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0} otherwise. The normal loss pulls the visible surface toward the input image in the early denoising stage, while the subsequent DiT steps continue to project the sample toward the learned shape distribution. As a result, the method improves alignment with the observed view without turning inference into unconstrained per-example fitting, and the generative prior continues to complete invisible regions and regularize the full shape.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the full procedure. The camera is calibrated once when the sampler first enters the early reconstruction window, because the DiT camera estimate is already close and the mask objective quickly removes the remaining alignment error. SDF refinement is then applied only for steps with t < t 1 t<t_{1} , each time using the corrected camera and the same input normal map. The final output of the algorithm is the last clean SDF voxel grid.

blocks.en: 5. Experiments
blocks.zh: 5.五. 实验

blocks.en: 5.1. Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.1. 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: We train Direct3D-V3 on 320K meshes from a high-quality subset of Objaverse-XL ( Deitke et al., 2023 ) . To examine data scalability, we also conduct an additional training experiment by adding approximately 200K private meshes to this public subset. For each mesh, we render 16 RGB images and 16 normal maps as conditioning images, with randomized viewpoints, illumination, and focal lengths.
blocks.zh: 我们从Objaverse-XL(Deitke等人,2023年)的高质量子集中,在320K meshes上训练Direct3D-V3. 为了审查数据的可扩展性,我们还进行了额外培训实验,在这个公共子集中增加了大约200K个私人网格。 对于每个网格,我们制作16个RGB图像和16个普通地图作为条件图像,它们有随机化的视线,照明,和焦距.

blocks.en: For image-to-3D generation, we evaluate on 102 input images from real photographs, web-collected images, and AI-generated images. Since these inputs do not have ground-truth 3D shapes, we measure the consistency between each input image and the generated geometry using two pretrained 3D representation models: Uni3D ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and ULIP-2 ( Xue et al., 2024 ) . These metrics compare the input-image feature with the generated-shape feature, providing complementary estimates of alignment between input images and generated geometry.
blocks.zh: 对于图像到3D生成,我们从真实的照片,网络收集的图像以及AI生成的图像中,对102个输入图像进行评估. 由于这些输入没有地面真实的3D形状,我们使用两个预先训练的3D表示模型来测量每个输入图像与生成的几何的一致性:Uni3D(周等人,2024年)和ULIP-2(薛等人,2024年). 这些度量衡将输入-图像特征与生成-形状特征进行比较,提供了输入图像与生成几何的对齐性互补估计.

blocks.en: For module ablations, we use a held-out Objaverse-XL subset that has no overlap with the training data. To evaluate geometric quality more directly, we report Normal-FID, a normal-rendering variant of the Fréchet Inception Distance ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) . Specifically, for each generated mesh and its corresponding ground-truth mesh, we render normal maps from identical camera views and compute FID between the generated and ground-truth normal renderings. This protocol focuses the ablation study on shape fidelity and surface quality.
blocks.zh: 对于模块模拟,我们使用一个与培训数据没有重叠的搁置Objaverse-XL子集。 为了更直接地评估几何质量,我们报告Fréchet Inception距离(Heusel等人,2017年)的正常变体Normal-FID。 具体地说,对于每个生成的网格及其相应的地面真实网格,我们通过相同的相机视图来制作正常的地图,并在生成的和地面真实的正常渲染之间计算出FID。 这份协议侧重于对形状忠诚度和表面质量的研究。

blocks.en: For generative reconstruction, we report quantitative results on Google Scanned Objects (GSO) ( Downs et al., 2022 ) . We employ Chamfer Distance (CD), F1-score at 0.95 and 0.99, and Volume IoU to evaluate reconstruction quality. Since GSO contains relatively simple scanned objects and does not fully reflect reconstruction quality on complex geometry, we additionally use images generated by AI and images collected from online communities for qualitative comparison.
blocks.zh: 关于基因重建,我们报告Google扫描对象(GSO)(Downs等人,2022年)的定量结果。 我们利用Chamfer距离(CD)、F1-分数0.95和0.99以及Volume IoU来评估重建质量。 由于GSO包含相对简单的扫描对象,在复杂的几何上没有充分反映重建质量,我们额外使用AI生成的图像和从在线社区收集的图像进行质的比较.

blocks.en: 5.2. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.2. 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Our latent-free DiT trains and samples directly on raw SDF voxel grids. We use a truncated SDF with a truncation threshold of 1 / 64 1/64 and a patch size of p = 8 p=8 . To obtain the surface patch indices, we follow the setting of Hunyuan3D 2.1 ( Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ) and train a vecset DiT as the first-stage generator, which quickly produces a coarse mesh for surface patch extraction. The patch-level DiT contains 17 blocks with hidden size 1536 and 16 attention heads, while the voxel-level DiT contains 2 blocks with voxel hidden size D v = 8 D_{v}=8 . All self-attention layers in the DiT use 3D shifted-window attention for efficiency. Blocks alternate between regular window attention and the same partition shifted by half a window on the 3D patch grid. We set each window to half of the patch grid resolution along every axis; the shifted partition lets consecutive layers cover offset neighborhoods and exchange information across window boundaries without global attention. Image conditioning features are extracted by DINOv2-Large from input images at resolution 1022 1022 . We train the model on 16 NVIDIA A800 GPUs with AdamW and bfloat16 mixed precision, and reduce memory use with gradient checkpointing and FSDP2. The loss weights are set to λ imr = 1 × 10 − 5 \lambda_{\mathrm{imr}}=1\times 10^{-5} , λ geo = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathrm{geo}}=1.0 , and λ cam = 5 × 10 − 2 \lambda_{\mathrm{cam}}=5\times 10^{-2} . Normal maps for geometric supervision are rendered at resolution 1024 1024 . During sampling, we use 15 flow-matching steps and classifier-free guidance scale 4.0. To stabilize high-resolution latent-free training, we adopt a progressive schedule from 256 3 256^{3} to 1536 3 1536^{3} resolution, as summarized in Table 1 .

blocks.en: 5.3. Comparison with Image-to-3D Generation Methods
blocks.zh: 5.3. 与图像到3D生成方法的比较

blocks.en: We evaluate Direct3D-V3 on the test images described in Section 5.1 , comparing against recent open-source image-to-3D methods including Michelangelo ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , Hunyuan3D 2.1 ( Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ) , Direct3D-S2 ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , UltraShape ( Jia et al., 2025 ) , and TRELLIS2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) . Table 2 reports quantitative results using Uni3D and ULIP-2, which measure consistency between the input image and generated shape in pretrained 3D feature spaces. Direct3D-V3 outperforms all competing methods on both metrics, and adding private training data further improves the scores. However, Uni3D and ULIP-2 mainly reflect semantic alignment with the conditioning image and cannot directly measure geometric precision, such as surface regularity, thin structures, and local details. We therefore conduct a user study with 1–5 quality ratings. As shown in Figure 6 , Direct3D-V3 receives the highest user preference, indicating that users favor the geometric quality of our generated meshes.
blocks.zh: 我们用第5.1节描述的测试图像来评价Direct3D-V3,比较最近的开源图像对3D方法,包括Michelangelo(赵等人,2023年),Hunyuan3D 2.1(Hunyuan3D等人,2025年),Direct3D-S2(吴等人,2026年),UltraShape(贾等人,2025年)和TRELIS2(Xiang等人,2026年). 表2使用Uni3D和ULIP-2报告定量结果,这些结果在预先训练的3D特征空间中测量输入图像和生成形状的一致性. Direct3D-V3在两个度量衡上都超越了所有竞争方法,加上私人培训数据进一步提高了分数. 然而,Uni3D和ULIP-2主要反映与条件图像的语义对齐,无法直接测量几何精度,如表面规律性,薄结构,以及局部细节. 因此,我们以1至5个质量评级进行用户研究。 如图6所示,Direct3D-V3获得用户最高偏好,表明用户倾向于我们生成的网格的几何质量.

blocks.en: Figure 7 provides a qualitative comparison of generated meshes. Hunyuan3D 2.1 usually captures the coarse object shape and produces stable overall geometry, but it tends to miss or smooth out fine structures, especially on hair, beard, ornaments, and other high-frequency regions. Direct3D-S2 generates richer local details, yet these details are sometimes less organized: surface patterns can become cluttered, and the generated geometry may drift from the conditioning image when the input contains dense structures or ambiguous contours. UltraShape follows the input silhouette well, but its geometric precision still has a visible ceiling on thin parts and high-frequency surface patterns. TRELLIS2 is the closest high-resolution competitor, since both TRELLIS2 and Direct3D-V3 scale to 1536 3 1536^{3} generation and can recover substantially more detail than lower-resolution methods. Even so, Direct3D-V3 produces more faithful and regular local geometry in several representative cases: it better preserves hair and beard structures in the first and fifth examples, sharper tire tread patterns in the second example, more complete facial details in the third example, and more regular ropes on the ship in the fourth example. Moreover, unlike TRELLIS2 and Direct3D-S2, our approach is implemented as a pure transformer architecture and does not require specialized sparse 3D convolution infrastructure, making the high-resolution generator simpler while remaining competitive with the strongest sparse 3D frameworks.
blocks.zh: 图7对生成的网格进行了定性比较。 Hunyuan3D 2.1通常捕捉粗糙的物体形状,并产生稳定的整体几何,但它往往会漏掉或滑出细细的结构,特别是在头发,胡子,饰物,以及其他高频区域. Direct3D-S2生成更丰富的局部细节,然而这些细节有时组织性较低:表面图案可能变得杂乱无章,当输入包含密集结构或模糊轮廓时,生成的几何图案可能会从条件图像中漂移. 超强 形状跟随输入的Silhouette井,但其几何精度在稀薄部分和高频表面图案上仍然有一个可见的天花板. TRELLIS2是最接近的高分辨率竞争对手,因为TRELLIS2和Direct3D-V3两个比例尺都达到了1536 3 1536^{3}的生成,并且比低分辨率方法可以大大恢复更详细. 即便如此,Direct3D-V3在几个具有代表性的案例中也产生了更忠实和规律的局部几何:它最好在第一例和第五例中保存头发和胡须结构,在第二例中轮胎胎面图案更锋利,在第三例中面部细节更完整,在第四例中船上的绳索更正规. 此外,与TRELLIS2和Direct3D-S2不同的是,我们的方法是作为纯变压器架构执行的,并不需要专用的稀疏的3D演化基础设施,使得高分辨率发电机更加简单,同时保持与最稀疏的3D框架的竞争.

blocks.en: 5.4. Generative Reconstruction Results
blocks.zh: 5.4. 基因重建成果

blocks.en: We further evaluate our Direct3D-V3 in the single-view generative reconstruction setting. We compare against TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , TRELLIS2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , CUPID ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , and ReconViaGen ( Chang et al., 2025 ) . Given a single image, Direct3D-V3 first samples a complete shape from the learned prior, uses the predicted camera parameters to establish the input view, and refines the native SDF prediction with normal-guided test-time optimization. Since the refinement is applied directly to the SDF grid, the observed surface can be corrected in the geometry domain while the diffusion prior continues to regularize unobserved regions.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports reconstruction accuracy on GSO using CD, F1-score at 0.95 and 0.99, and Volume IoU. Direct3D-V3 achieves the best CD and F1 scores among all compared methods, while obtaining a competitive Volume IoU slightly below TRELLIS2. Although these results validate our reconstruction framework on a standard benchmark, GSO contains relatively simple scanned objects and does not fully reveal how different methods handle complex geometry. We therefore further compare on AI images and community images, which contain denser local structures, richer visual styles, and more challenging fine detail. As shown in Figure 8 , CUPID, ReconViaGen, TRELLIS, and TRELLIS2 recover plausible complete shapes, but their surfaces are often over-smoothed or locally inconsistent with the input image on thin structures, concave parts, and fine details. blocks.en: We also extend our framework to multi-view inputs with minimal changes. We concatenate the DINOv2 image tokens extracted from all views and inject them into the latent-free DiT through the same cross-attention layers, fine-tuning the model for 20K steps. At inference time, we use the mesh generated by the TRELLIS MultiDiffusion pipeline to obtain the surface patch indices. We evaluate this setting on scenes from the standard Tanks and Temples dataset ( Knapitsch et al., 2017 ) ; the qualitative results are shown in Figure 9 , where our method reconstructs meshes with sharper and more complete surface details than competing approaches.

blocks.en: Effect of each core component. Table 4 and Figure 10 isolate the contribution of each component in the latent-free geometry pipeline. With only the patch-level DiT, the SDF values within each selected patch are encoded as channels of a patch token, so local intra-patch variation is not modeled explicitly at voxel granularity. Adding the voxel-level DiT introduces an intra-patch refinement stage that models the local SDF field directly over voxel tokens, improving surface detail and reducing Normal-FID from 92.96 to 75.80. However, the generated meshes still contain many holes, reflecting the missing manifold prior of a VAE decoder. IMR addresses this issue by regularizing local SDF transitions around the zero level set, greatly reducing holes and improving mesh validity. Table 5 further shows that IMR sharply reduces boundary edges at both 256 3 256^{3} and 1024 3 1024^{3} resolutions. After this boundary reduction, standard post-processing hole filling can close the remaining small openings and produce watertight meshes. With normal-rendering supervision, the prediction is optimized entirely in the geometry domain after mesh extraction, further improving surface quality and achieving the best Normal-FID of 68.97.

IMR解决这一问题的方法是,在零平面设定周围规范当地SDF的过渡,大大减少漏洞,提高网格有效性. 表5还表明,在256 3 256^{3}和1024 3 1024^{3}的分辨率上,婴儿死亡率急剧缩小。 在这种边界缩小后,标准的加工后孔填充可以关闭剩余的小开口,并产生紧水密层. 在正常服从的监督下,预测在网状提取后完全在几何领域进行优化,进一步改善了表面质量,实现了68.97的最佳正常-FID.

blocks.en: Effect of patch size. Table 6 reports the generation quality under different patch sizes. Smaller patches assign each token to a finer SDF region, which preserves more geometric detail and improves Normal-FID. However, reducing the patch size also increases the patch sequence length, leading to higher memory and attention cost. Larger patches are cheaper but blur local structures because each token must represent a broader surface neighborhood. We therefore choose p = 8 p=8 as the default setting, which provides a practical trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We presented Direct3D-V3, a latent-free DiT framework that revisits the need for VAE-based compression in high-fidelity 3D generation. Instead of modeling compressed 3D latent representations, Direct3D-V3 performs diffusion in the native voxel domain by directly denoising raw SDF voxel grids. To make this formulation scalable, the model uses sparse surface patch modeling and a dual-granularity DiT, where a patch-level transformer captures global shape structure and a lightweight voxel-level transformer restores local SDF variation. Beyond scalability, Direct3D-V3 makes the native SDF output geometrically reliable by constraining neighboring SDF values with implicit manifold regularization, supervising the extracted surface through rendered normals, and estimating the conditioning camera with an auxiliary branch for better view alignment. The same native SDF voxel output also enables generative reconstruction, where test-time normal guidance refines the observed surface while the learned prior completes unseen regions. Experiments show competitive or superior performance against recent image-to-3D methods, together with finer local geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Direct3D-V3,一个潜伏的无线DiT框架,它重新审视了在高真性3D生成中基于VAE压缩的需求. Direct3D-V3与其模拟压缩的3D潜在表示,不如直接去除原始的SDF voxel网格,在原生的voxel域中进行扩散. 为使这种配体可伸缩,该模型采用了稀疏的表面补丁模型和双角二T,其中补丁级变压器能捕捉到全球形状结构,轻量级的voxel级变压器能恢复局部的SDF变异. 除了可伸缩性,Direct3D-V3通过以隐含的多态化约束相邻的SDF值,通过渲染的常态来监督提取的表面,以及用辅助分支来估计调制相机,使本地SDF输出几何性能可靠,以更好的视图对齐. 同样的原生SDF voxel输出也使得基因重建成为可能,测试时间的正常指导精炼了观测到的表面,而学习到的先前完成的则是看不见的区域. 实验显示与近代图像到3D方法相比具有竞争力或优异性能,加上更细的局部几何.

blocks.en: Limitations. The current framework has two main limitations. First, generative reconstruction depends on accurate first-stage surface indices, which define the sparse SDF support used by the latent-free DiT. If this support misses image-observed structures or places patches in inconsistent regions, test-time normal guidance may distort the mesh, especially around thin structures or ambiguous silhouettes. Figure 13 visualizes this failure mode, where inaccurate first-stage surface indices cause normal-guided refinement to over-update the native SDF and produce distorted geometry. Improving robustness to inaccurate sparse support remains an important direction, potentially through stronger camera estimation, guidance with uncertainty estimates, or more constrained geometry refinement. Second, Direct3D-V3 currently focuses on geometry only. In principle, the latent-free formulation can be extended beyond SDF values by adding channels for texture, material, or PBR attributes to the voxel grid. However, jointly modeling geometry and appearance in this native space will require additional design to keep training stable and to preserve consistency between surface structure and material signals. We leave this unified latent-free geometry and appearance generation setting for future work.
blocks.zh: 限制。 目前的框架有两个主要的局限性。 首先,基因重建依赖于精确的第一阶段表面指数,这些指数定义了潜无DiT所使用的稀疏的SDF支持. 如果此支持错过了图像观测结构或将补丁放置在不一致的区域,测试时的正常制导可能会扭曲网格,特别是围绕薄结构或模糊的圆筒。 图13可视化了这种故障模式,即不准确的第一阶段表面指数会导致正常的制导改进,以过度更新本土的SDF,并产生扭曲的几何. 改善对不准确的零星支持的稳健性仍然是一个重要方向,可能通过更强的相机估计、有不确定性估计的指导,或更受限制的几何改进。 第二,Direct3D-V3目前只注重几何. 原则上,通过在voxel网格中加入纹理,材料,或PBR属性的通道,可以将潜在无配体扩展到SDF值之外. 然而,在这个本土空间中联合建模几何和外观需要额外的设计来保持训练的稳定,并保持表面结构和物质信号的一致性. 我们为今后的工作留下了这种统一的无潜伏几何和造型环境。

blocks.en: Figure 15 provides additional qualitative comparisons for image-to-3D generation. These examples complement the main results in Figure 7 and include more diverse input images. Across these cases, Direct3D-V3 produces coherent complete shapes while preserving sharper local geometry and more regular surface details than competing methods.
blocks.zh: 图15提供了图像到3D生成的其他质量比较。 这些例子补充了图7中的主要结果,包括了更加多样化的输入图像. 在这些案例中,Direct3D-V3产生连贯的完整形状,同时保存更尖锐的局部几何和比竞争方法更规律的表面细节.
